meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 多出一个真实电话号码，可收发短信、接听 AI 语音来电；短信和通话两个方向都经 dial CLI 走。它会从 channels 分支复制 Dial 适配器与配对辅助文件并注册。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 加一个能收发短信、接 AI 语音电话的真实号码时触发；它会复制 Dial 适配器、注册 pair-dial 配对步骤并安装 dial CLI。

say.text: 给我加一个 Dial 号码，用来收发短信和接电话
say.note: 开始复制适配器、安装 dial CLI 并走配对流程

say.text: 这条 Dial 线路只允许我自己的手机发短信进来
把这条 Dial 线路设为公开，谁发短信都能回

howto.what_en: Claude gains a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via Dial (getdial.ai), wired both ways through the dial CLI. It copies the Dial adapter and pairing helper from the channels branch and registers the adapter.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want Claude on a real number for SMS or AI voice calls; it copies the Dial adapter, registers the pair-dial step and installs the dial CLI.

say_en.text: Add a Dial number so Claude can send SMS and take calls
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dial CLI, starts pairing

say_en.text: Keep this Dial line owner-only, just my phone can text in
say_en.note: Sets the line's unknown_sender_policy to strict

say_en.text: Make this Dial line public so anyone can text the agent
say_en.note: Sets the line's unknown_sender_policy to public
